title: Iterated coupling as a product expectation
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set, let $\kappa$ be a probability law on $\Omega\times\Omega$, let $n$ be a natural number, and let $f,g:\Omega^n\to\mathbb R$. The iterated coupling expectation of $f$ and $g$ equals the expectation of $f(x)g(y)$ when the $n$ coordinate pairs are sampled independently, each with law $\kappa$, and $x$ and $y$ are formed from their first and second entries, respectively.
